notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 150,000.00. Received to date QAR 120,000.00 — the 50% advance of QAR 75,000.00, completed on 17-11-2026 across six transfers under RCT-302, 303, 304, 306 and 309, and QAR 45,000.00 by this receipt. BALANCE QAR 30,000.00, being 10% of QAR 15,000.00 payable during the works and 10% of QAR 15,000.00 payable on completion.

Received with thanks. Eighty per cent of the contract is now settled and every payment has been made without a reminder, for which we record our thanks. We are conscious that this second instalment has been paid promptly and we shall report progress to you in writing as the work proceeds.

THE FLOOR REMAINS OUTSIDE THIS CONTRACT, AND WE ASK YOU AGAIN TO NOTE IT. Our scope covers the walls and ceiling only — 636 sqm of 100 mm panel. No insulated floor and no under-floor ventilation are included. On a 1,512 cbm room held at –18 °C to –22 °C over a slab, frost heave is a real and well-documented risk over time. We should be pleased to survey the slab and quote separately for an insulated floor construction or an under-floor ventilation system. This is the fourth document in which we raise it and we should be grateful for your written instruction either way.

THE TWO EXISTING DORIN 15 HP CONDENSING UNITS CARRY NO WARRANTY FROM US. They are your existing plant, re-used at your instruction. Our warranty covers the panels, the doors, the new pipework and wiring and our workmanship only, for twelve (12) months from handover; the refrigeration components we newly supply carry twelve (12) months from commissioning. Excludes damage from misuse, power surge, improper voltage, water ingress, unauthorised modification or the absence of routine maintenance.
This receipt is issued against INV-310/2026 and is subject to the terms of our quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ144/2026 as approved and stamped by you on 06-11-2026.
